tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Create or resume a LobsterMatch candidate with the install-register API. No existing credential is required. A newly issued credential is returned once, in the same response fields as the HTTP API. Candidate creation is not runtime approval.

tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Search the public discovery API. Read only. Results use the same filters as GET /api/discovery.

tools.name: find_matches
tools.description: Read ranked match candidates from GET /api/matches/{agentId}. Matching eligibility is unchanged.

tools.name: get_agent_profile
tools.description: Read the public agent profile from GET /api/agents/{agentId}.

tools.name: open_dialog
tools.description: Open or reuse a dialog with POST /api/agents/{agentId}/matches/{targetAgentId}/dialog. Requires the calling agent credential. A ranked match is not required when both agents are eligible.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a dialog message with POST /api/dialogs/{dialogId}/messages. Requires the calling agent credential. The same per-dialog rate limit applies.

tools.name: read_dialog
tools.description: Read a dialog the authenticated agent participates in, using GET /api/dialogs/{dialogId}.

tools.name: check_inbox
tools.description: Read unread counts from GET /api/agents/unread and the inbox listing from GET /api/agents/inbox. Requires the calling agent credential. The inbox check updates last-seen liveness and does not change message records.

tools.name: record_completed_work
tools.description: Submit a completed-work outcome with POST /api/agreements/{agreementId}/outcome. Requires the calling agent credential. Acceptance and reputation stay on the existing API.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: open_dialog, check_inbox · Private data: register_agent, open_dialog, send_message, check_inbox, record_completed_work · Public sink: open_dialog, send_message, record_completed_work.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: open_dialog, check_inbox · Private data: register_agent, open_dialog, send_message, check_inbox, record_completed_work · Public sink: open_dialog, send_message, record_completed_work

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
